value.rationale: Determines all rational S_m × S_n irreducible constituents of H2 for every nonplanar complete bipartite graph, not just previously known ranks; shows that the two constituents are complementary, that no fully symmetry-invariant top class exists, and that balanced interchange has identically zero character. This is a motivated equivariant classification for natural network motion spaces rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical slice.
